lines.text: Christ is the mediator of a new covenant so that those who are called may receive the promised eternal inheritance.
A will takes effect only when the one who made it has died, so even the first covenant required blood.
Moses took the blood of calves and goats, with water, scarlet wool, and hyssop, and sprinkled the doorposts and all the people.
Christ entered Mount Sinai itself to appear for us before God, not to offer Himself again and again.
Christ was offered once to bear the sins of many, and He will appear a second time to bring salvation to those who eagerly await Him.
